## What's new

### Larvyn is open source
The source code is now public under the [MIT License](https://github.com/larvyn/larvyn/blob/master/LICENSE): [github.com/larvyn/larvyn](https://github.com/larvyn/larvyn). It is still free, and always will be.

### Agents can drive Larvyn
A new `larvyn` command and MCP server give agents the same tools you have in the window: the project's context, terminals, the dev stack (start it and wait until it's ready), Artisan, tests, log errors, models, read-only database queries, ports, and other agents (start, send, status, wait). Locks let several agents take turns on a shared resource, like the database.
- Settings → **Agents know Larvyn** installs a Larvyn skill and a session hook for Claude Code and Codex (or run `larvyn agents setup`). Only agents you have installed are set up, and **Remove** takes out only what Larvyn added.
- The Laravel playbooks (CRUD, tests, N+1, security review, upgrade…) are MCP prompts too: in Claude Code they show up in the `/` menu, filled in for your project.

### Spec first (Elephant-Goldfish)
A new way to run agents in the Agents view: one agent writes a spec, a fresh one reviews it cold until it's ready, builders implement it in their own worktrees, and an auditor checks each attempt against the spec before you merge.

### Review comments on an agent's diff
In the review panel, click a line number (shift-click for a range) to comment, then send all the comments to the agent as one follow-up.

### Light theme
Settings → Workbench → **Theme**: follow the system, light or dark. Terminals and the code editor switch too.

### Shared project settings
Commit a `.larvyn/project.json` to give your team the same commands (in ⌘K and a new **Commands** card), extra dev-stack items, required plugins, and setup steps for each new agent worktree. See [examples/project](https://github.com/larvyn/larvyn/tree/master/examples/project).

### Privacy
Settings → About has a **Privacy** card listing every connection Larvyn makes, and when.

## Changed
- **Quieter defaults for new installs:** agents ask before acting, only shells start again when Larvyn opens (services and agents wait for **Relaunch**), and Flock is off until you turn it on. Existing installs keep their settings.

## Fixed
- **macOS:** "Open a project" no longer sets off privacy prompts for Music, Photos, Desktop, Documents, Downloads or network volumes. When those folders are skipped, the picker says so, with **Search them too**. Folders served by Herd and Valet are searched first, on every platform.
- The breadcrumbs no longer run under the search bar in a narrow window or with a long branch name.
- Terminals no longer cut off their last rows.
- A relaunched agent follows the current permission setting, not the one it started with.
- The command copied from the Artisan form is safely quoted for your shell.
